kind: FRED working point evaluated on the lab recordings
notes: Evaluates fred/data/working_points/working_point_bayes_baseline_ss_box_f1.json unchanged (no search, no re-tuning) on all 10 lab recordings, with the lab copy of the pipeline (lab/code/lab_bayes_working_point.py evaluate_point / metrics_from_rows / score_of / write_best), mode=baseline, tracking off.

Data: lab/frame_data per-pixel files frames_<rec>_baseline.csv.gz, built with lab/code/common/frame_features.py --mode baseline (default settings, drone bands 'all', min_present_harmonics 0, as in the FRED caches).

Scored with the objective of its FRED search (mean box-level F1, no recall floor). No skip-start: lab recordings have no lead-in, so whole recordings count. Lab camera is 640x480 vs FRED 1280x720; pixel-based parameters (min_rotor_pixels, min_box_area, alpha) are applied unchanged.
